name: Ew, I Stepped In Shit
look: A two-panel black-and-white comic with gray shading. Top: a man in a T-shirt balances on one leg and grimaces at the bottom of his raised shoe, saying "Ew, I stepped in shit." Bottom: a close-up of the shoe's blank gray sole held in his fingers.
use: Something the poster dislikes is pasted onto the shoe sole in the bottom panel, as if it were what he stepped in. It's a way to call a trend, show or thing gross.
slots: the disliked thing (on the shoe sole, bottom panel)
examples: Cold fries from the bottom of the bag
Raisins in what I thought was a chocolate chip cookie
